notes:
Key account: building an omnichannel agent-assist offering. Primary tech constraints: must surface exact citations (snippet + permalink), keep citations fresher than 24h for KB content originating in Confluence and product change logs, and support multi-source retrieval (Zendesk tickets, Confluence articles, S3-hosted release notes).

POC goals (explicit):
- Show end-to-end RAG pipeline: ingestion -> vector store -> retrieval+rerank -> answer with 2-3 prioritized citations.
- Proof of citation fidelity (show source offsets, verbatim excerpt).
- Demonstrate burst resilience: 300ms median suggestion latency SLA for agent-assist; 95th < 750ms under 200 RPS sustained, 95th < 1s under 800 RPS spike.
- Tool-calling: create/attach/update ServiceNow incidents + attach summary.
- Summarization: 3-line automated ticket summaries + suggested routing tags.

Customer preferences / requests:
- Prefer private deployment in VPC for pilot, with option to move to on-prem for regulated customers. "We can't have raw transcripts leave region" (legal).
- Vector DB: evaluating Milvus vs Pinecone; asked about Redwood's recommended hot/cold index pattern and backing store.
- Embedding dim: currently generating 1536-d embeddings; asked about batching impact and quantization profiles to reduce GPU memory during inference.
- Want caching TTL controls per-route (agent suggestion vs full article search). Suggested TTL 45m for agent suggestions, 24h for KB metadata.

POC notes & friction: short fragments from call: "need citations or we can't trust answers"; "if we lose throughput in spikes, agents will fallback to manual triage". Legal wants a retention policy map and KMS flowchart.

Technical acceptance criteria (pilot):
- 95% citation recall for top-3 retrieval on test prompt set (1k prompts).
- Tool-calling success rate > 99% in integration environment.
- No PII leakage observed in simulated transcripts (sec test).
